word_bank.example: I vacuum the living room carpet every Friday before Shabbat.
I did three loads of laundry on Sunday and hung everything out to dry.
The shelves were dusty because nobody had cleaned them in two weeks.
After sweeping the kitchen floor, I mopped it with soapy water.
Please take out the garbage — the bin is completely full.
I spent the morning trying to organize the storage room — it was a mess.
The kitchen tap was dripping, so I called someone to repair it.
Could you sweep the porch? There are dry leaves everywhere.
Washing the dishes is my least favourite chore, but someone has to do it.
We made a cleaning schedule so that everyone in the family shares the chores.

stage_2_story.text_en:
Every Saturday morning, David likes to do a thorough clean of the house. This week, he made a schedule and divided the chores among the family.

David started by vacuuming the living room and the bedrooms. The rugs were quite dusty because nobody had cleaned them since last weekend. After that, he swept the kitchen floor to remove crumbs and dust, then mopped it with hot soapy water until it was shining.

His son Yoav was responsible for taking out the garbage. There were two full bags — one from the kitchen and one from the bathroom. His daughter Mia was asked to organize the hallway cupboard, which had become a mess of shoes, bags, and jackets.

David's wife sorted and started the laundry. She did two full loads — one for dark clothes and one for light ones.

In the afternoon, David noticed that the bathroom tap was dripping. He decided it needed a repair, so he watched a short video online and fixed it himself in about twenty minutes.

By evening, the apartment was clean and tidy. Everyone felt proud of what they had accomplished together as a team.
